name: art-liz-design-system
description: Design system pessoal com React, TypeScript e Emotion.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @art-liz/tokens && npm run build -w @art-liz/react && npm run build -w @art-liz/playground
scripts.test: npm run build -w @art-liz/tokens && npm run test -w @art-liz/react
scripts.storybook: npm run build -w @art-liz/tokens && npm run build -w @art-liz/react && npm run storybook -w @art-liz/storybook
scripts.build:storybook:homolog: npm run build -w @art-liz/tokens && npm run build -w @art-liz/react && npm run build:homolog -w @art-liz/storybook
scripts.build:storybook:prod: npm run build -w @art-liz/tokens && npm run build -w @art-liz/react && npm run build:prod -w @art-liz/storybook
